cluster_provisioning: Integrator supplies a disposable local cluster and explicit kube-context. The runner does not provision, select or mutate a cluster.
namespace: New run-owned namespace with io.attune.acceptance.owner=<run-id>; reject existing namespaces or foreign resources.
artifacts: same compatible immutable platform/init images as Compose
versioned owned object provider for object mode
startup_contract: helm --wait waits ordinary Pods before post-install publication. Ordinary API/host/web startup must use platform readiness, not content readiness. Publisher and later content hooks must complete and prove exact pins.
writers_drained: Before F pre-06005 preflight, stop and join every application writer and old workload. Never restart between parking and ordinary migration through 06006. No checksum edits or reset.
cleanup: Join fixture processes, stop workloads, await Pod deletion, inspect exact namespace ownership, uninstall only this release, then remove only this owned namespace/PVCs after native physical cleanup evidence. Never delete cluster-global or external volumes.
result: Offline helm template output is not live cluster or UI lifecycle acceptance. Missing any matrix entry remains INCOMPLETE, not PASS.
